What I Do

How I work & what I deliver

Cities are messy, unequal, and full of people making decisions with incomplete information. This is how I help fix that.

🗺️

Spatial Analysis & GIS

I use ArcGIS Pro, QGIS, and R/Python to analyze urban patterns, map vulnerabilities, and produce data-driven spatial narratives for planning decisions.

  • Heat vulnerability mapping (Climate Equity LA)
  • Spatial joins, overlay analysis, cartographic design
  • ArcGIS StoryMaps for public communication
🏘️

Community-Based Research

I conduct qualitative fieldwork — interviews, observation, and participatory methods — in self-produced neighborhoods in Lima and other urban contexts.

  • 8+ in-depth interviews on housing consolidation trajectories
  • Socioeconomic data analysis for policy integration
  • Research reports for academic and practitioner audiences
📊

Data Analysis & Policy Briefs

I clean, analyze, and visualize complex datasets in R and Python, then translate findings into clear policy briefs and reports for decision-makers.

  • Quantitative & statistical analysis (regression, descriptive stats)
  • Power BI dashboards and data visualizations
  • Heat Action and Resilience Plan contributions (City of LA)
Selected Work

Projects & Portfolio

A few of the problems I've worked on — and what I actually built to address them.

Fieldwork · Housing · Lima
Housing Consolidation in Self-Produced Neighborhoods, Lima
Qualitative fieldwork examining housing consolidation trajectories in Lima's self-produced neighborhoods — combining 8 in-depth interviews with spatial and socioeconomic data analysis for Habitar Construcción Colectiva.
Learn More
This project examines how families in Lima's self-produced neighborhoods consolidate their housing over time. Through 8 in-depth interviews and spatial analysis of socioeconomic data, I documented consolidation trajectories and identified patterns across case-study communities. Findings were synthesized into research reports for both academic and practitioner audiences at Habitar Construcción Colectiva.
[Add project URL or report link]
GIS · StoryMap · Anti-Muslim Bias
ArcGIS StoryMap: Mosque Permitting & Anti-Muslim Bias
Designed and produced an ArcGIS StoryMap translating peer-reviewed research on anti-Muslim bias in U.S. mosque permitting into a public-facing interactive narrative — UCLA ITS.
Coming Soon
For Prof. Adam Millard-Ball at UCLA's Institute of Transportation Studies, I built an ArcGIS StoryMap communicating research findings on anti-Muslim bias in mosque permitting processes across the United States. The project integrated geospatial visualizations, interactive maps, timelines, and multimedia elements to make peer-reviewed academic research accessible to broader audiences. Add the live StoryMap URL below when published.
[StoryMap in review — link coming soon]
Policy · Heat Equity · Los Angeles
Heat Resilience Mapping, Climate Equity LA
Analyzed community data sources to map heat vulnerability across LA neighborhoods and inform the City's Heat Action and Resilience Plan.
Learn More
At Climate Equity LA (UCLA), I analyzed multiple community data sources to identify priorities and equity gaps related to extreme heat resilience across Los Angeles neighborhoods. I produced summary briefs with data visualizations and helped translate community-based insights into actionable strategies for the City of Los Angeles Heat Action and Resilience Plan. Supervised by Prof. V. Kelly Turner.

About Me

The person behind the maps

I'm Michelle — a Peruvian planner and researcher who moved from designing environmental systems to understanding the people living inside them.

I'm a second-year dual-degree graduate student at UCLA (M.U.R.P. + M.A. Latin American Studies), trained as an Environmental Engineer at Peru's National University of Engineering. My career has taken me from heat equity mapping across Los Angeles neighborhoods, to qualitative fieldwork in Lima's self-produced settlements, to designing ArcGIS StoryMaps for peer-reviewed research on civil rights and urban planning. I work in R, Python, ArcGIS Pro, and Power BI — and I've learned that the most powerful thing you can do with data is make it matter to someone who doesn't speak the language of data.

Teaching & Tutoring

TOEFL Preparation Coaching

I scored 111/120 on the TOEFL iBT — placing me in the 99th percentile — and I'm certified for English-language teaching through UCLA's Test of Oral Proficiency (TOP). I also bring four years of experience teaching and supporting language learners and students from underserved communities — developing communication skills, academic confidence, and test-taking strategies.

I offer personalized TOEFL preparation coaching for students aiming for competitive scores in graduate and professional programs. Sessions are tailored to your current level, target score, and weak areas across Reading, Listening, Speaking, and Writing.
